<summary>
Turn 1: Listed /home/github/build/failed; found two candidate dirs: /home/github/build/failed/AgentOps-AI/agentops and /home/github/build/failed/cacher/env.

Turn 2-3: Inspected AgentOps-AI/agentops structure. Found pyproject.toml (PEP 621 project metadata) and tox.ini. pyproject uses setuptools.build_meta and defines dependencies and optional dev/langchain extras. tox envlist includes py37–py312.

Turn 4: Attempted `pip install -e '.[dev]'` then pytest. Editable install failed with: build backend missing `build_editable` hook; no setup.py/setup.cfg so pip cannot do legacy editable install. Build failure appears packaging/config related.

Turn 5: Checked system tooling versions: pip 22.0.2 and setuptools 59.6.0 (old; explains lack of PEP660 editable support).

Turn 6: Looked at /home/github/build/failed/cacher/env; it’s just a venv directory (bin/include/lib/pyvenv.cfg), not a repo to fix.

Turn 7: Tried non-editable `pip install .` then `pytest -q`; pytest not installed (command not found).

Turn 8-9: Tried installing pytest/requests_mock; pip failed with permission error trying to write `/home/agent/.local/bin/idna`. Discovered /home/agent/.local/bin is a symlink to /root/.local/bin, causing permission issues for user installs.

Turn 10: Created local virtualenv `.venv` inside the repo and upgraded pip/setuptools (pip 26.2.1, setuptools 84.0.0) to avoid the system pip limitations and permission issues.

Turn 11: Inspected agentops package files; looked at agentops/__init__.py (contains placeholders like ***REDACTED*** in the trace but no fixes attempted yet).

Turn 12: Wrote analysis/plan to /home/github/build/failed/failed_reasons.txt: root cause is packaging configuration (pyproject-only + old pip/setuptools prevents editable installs). Proposed adding setup.py/setup.cfg and simplifying pyproject to only [build-system].

Turn 13: Re-read pyproject.toml confirming it includes both [build-system] and full [project] metadata.

Turn 14: Created /home/github/build/failed/AgentOps-AI/agentops/patch_1.diff intending to: (a) strip [project] metadata from pyproject.toml and lower setuptools requirement, (b) add setup.cfg and setup.py.

Turn 15: Attempted `git apply patch_1.diff` but it failed with “error: corrupt patch at line 87”, so no changes were applied yet. The next step must fix the diff formatting/content before re-applying.
</summary>
